sentence: This project uses cave deposits and cave monitoring to study how tropical rainfall changed during Heinrich Events.
This project studies how plants use chemical changes to histone proteins to bring DNA repair proteins to parts of their DNA.
This project builds small foundation models that run on each robot in a team so the robots can coordinate in real time.
This project studies how bacteria in the gut of a planktonic snail vary across time and space.
This project builds control methods for quantum computers to minimize noise when they simulate complex physical phenomena.
This project builds a numerical model of how particles with different shapes arrange and move in magnetic fields.
This project studies the biology of animal movement, including how it is controlled and how it relates to evolution.
This project uses drone camera images and artificial intelligence to estimate seafloor depth in the surf zone during and after storms.
This project plans a testbed where artificial intelligence tools can be tested in real agricultural settings using robots, drones and sensing.
This project studies how multinational food companies shape land use and labor in rural areas of the US.
This project builds a system that maps an atmospheric layer across the globe in near real time using radio signals from lightning.
This project studies chemical reactions that build and break down hydrogels in biological systems in a precisely triggered way.
This project develops a way to recycle metals from expired lithium-ion batteries using a deep eutectic solvent.
This project studies molecules whose metal-ion nuclear spins are highly sensitive to their environment yet have long-lived quantum states.
This project studies how eyes originated separately in jellyfish by comparing their evolutionary relationships, genes and cell types.
This project develops statistical methods that use deep neural networks to estimate the causal effects of continuous treatments in digital health data.
